body:
Copied emily.cli's own inline 'Generate Construct Bundle' step (find over source, concatenate into one *_CONSTRUCT.txt, upload as a CI artifact) into EDIS, MJOLNIR, gpt2-alpine-c, GOLDENBAND, SKULDMARK, GTA7, PARENA, REDGARDEN, and WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS -- the 9 repos S202-18's audit found had real CI but no construct step. GOLDENBAND got a new standalone construct.yml instead of a step inside blender-tools.yml (that file only fires on workflow_dispatch or a push to incoming/, never an ordinary source push -- a step there would almost never regenerate). Every find pattern verified locally for a non-empty match before pushing. Live-verified in real GitHub Actions CI, all 9/9 green: EDIS 338fea0, MJOLNIR 6ec15ee (construct job itself green; its separate build job's failure is a pre-existing, unrelated missing-secret gap), gpt2-alpine-c d8dd7b1 (construct's own Linux job passed; Windows job's failure is the same pre-existing gap), GOLDENBAND 7abe36c, SKULDMARK 69793e9, GTA7 4b62e81, PARENA 3c8844c, REDGARDEN 511c4ee (full pipeline including auto-release), WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS 874ec6c.

⚓ ☃
title: S202-19: construct CI step added to all 9 gap repos, all live-verified green
